people.name: Wolfram von Richthofen
people.nameZh: 沃爾弗拉姆·馮·里希特霍芬

body.zh-Hant: 1895年10月10日生於西里西亞的巴爾茨多夫。1911至1913年就讀柏林利希特費爾德的主要軍校，一戰期間先在第4驃騎兵團服役，1918年轉入第1戰鬥機聯隊並取得八次空戰勝利。戰後他於1920至1923年在漢諾威工業大學攻讀機械工程，1923年以降為少尉重返國防軍。
body.en: Born on 10 October 1895 at Barzdorf in Silesia, he attended the main cadet school at Lichterfelde near Berlin in 1911–13. In the First World War he served first in Hussar Regiment 4, then moved in 1918 to Jagdgeschwader 1 and scored eight aerial victories. He studied mechanical engineering at the Technical University of Hanover in 1920–23 and rejoined the Reichswehr in 1923 with a reduction to lieutenant.

citations.quote: 10.10.1895 geboren in Barzdorf/Kreis Striegau
absolvierte R. 1911-13 die Hauptkadettenanstalt in Lichterfelde bei Berlin
1914-17 im Husaren- Rgt. Nr. 4
Bis Kriegsende errang er acht Luftsiege.
studierte R. 1920-23 an der TH Hannover Maschinenbau
trat unter Rückstufung zum Leutnant 1923 in die Reichswehr ein.

heading.en: Luftwaffe service and the Spanish Civil War

body.zh-Hant: 1934年3月1日他轉入帝國航空部任處長。1936年11月10日起任「禿鷲軍團」前身之第88特遣隊負責人，兼任軍團參謀長；1938年11月1日晉升少將，出任第88指揮參謀部（禿鷲軍團）指揮官。他在西班牙參與新機種的實戰測試，並因當地的猛烈空襲經驗，被命令組建直接支援陸軍的航空軍。
body.en: On 1 March 1934 he was taken into the Reich Air Ministry as a department head. From 10 November 1936 he headed Versuchskommando 88, serving as chief of staff of the Condor Legion, and on 1 November 1938 he became a major general and commander of Führungsstab 88 (Condor Legion). In Spain he took a major part in testing new aircraft in action and, on the strength of the experience gained there, was ordered to raise an air corps for direct army support.

(Chef des Stabes "Legion Condor")

heading.en: VIII Fliegerkorps in the early campaigns

body.zh-Hant: 1939年10月3日他出任第8航空軍的軍長，1940年7月19日晉升航空兵上將。這個以俯衝轟炸機為主力的航空軍，在德軍的進攻戰役中位居中心，為對波蘭、法國與巴爾幹的勝利創造了重要條件。
body.en: On 3 October 1939 he became commanding general of VIII Fliegerkorps and on 19 July 1940 General der Flieger. Employed at the centre of the German offensive campaigns, the corps, with its dive-bombers above all, created important preconditions for the victories over Poland, France and in the Balkans.

citations.quote: 03.10.1939 Kommandierender General VIII.
19.07.1940 General der Flieger
Das im Zentrum der dt. Angriffsfeldzüge
unter seiner Führung seit 1939 eingesetzte VIII. Fliegerkorps
Voraussetzungen für die Siege gegen Polen, Frankreich und auf dem Balkan.

heading.zh-Hant: 第四、第二航空艦隊與晚年

body.zh-Hant: 1942年7月20日他成為第4航空艦隊司令兼東南部司令；該艦隊未能補給在史達林格勒被圍的第6集團軍，他仍於1943年2月16日晉升元帥。1943年6月12日轉任駐義大利的第2航空艦隊司令，1944年10月因病解除指揮，1945年7月12日在巴特伊施爾的空軍醫院去世。
body.en: On 20 July 1942 he became chief of Luftflotte 4 and Befehlshaber Südost; the fleet failed to supply the Sixth Army encircled at Stalingrad, yet he was promoted field marshal on 16 February 1943. On 12 June 1943 he took over Luftflotte 2 in Italy, was relieved of his command in October 1944, and died on 12 July 1945 in the Luftwaffe hospital at Bad Ischl.

im Okt. 1944 von seinem Kommando entbunden

people.nameZhOrig: 沃尔弗拉姆·冯·里希特霍芬

body.zh-Hant: 1881年10月4日生於柏林。1900年自軍校畢業後成為近衛擲彈兵團的少尉，1912年被調入大總參謀部，第一次世界大戰期間在多個單位擔任總參軍官，1921年以少校身分被接收進國防軍。
body.en: He was born in Berlin on 4 October 1881. After cadet training he became a lieutenant in a Guards Grenadier regiment in 1900, was called into the Great General Staff in 1912, served as a general staff officer in various units during the First World War, and in 1921 was taken into the Reichswehr as a major.

citations.quote: 4. Oktober: Walther von Brauchitsch wird in Berlin
wird Brauchitsch Leutnant in einem Garde-Grenadierregiment
Einberufung in den Großen Generalstab.
Im Ersten Weltkrieg ist er in verschiedenen Einheiten Generalstabsoffizier.
Brauchitsch wird als Major in die Reichswehr übernommen

body.zh-Hant: 1927年任第6軍區參謀長，1929年任國防部陸軍訓練處處長；1933年2月1日接替布隆貝格，任第1師師長兼第1軍區（東普魯士）司令。1937年他以砲兵上將身分獲得統率陸軍全部機動化部隊的第4集團司令部。
body.en: In 1927 he became chief of staff of Wehrkreis VI and in 1929 head of the army training department in the Reichswehr ministry. On 1 February 1933, succeeding Blomberg, he became commander of the 1st Division and of Wehrkreis I (East Prussia). In 1937, as General der Artillerie, he took Group Command 4, which united the army's motorised formations.

citations.quote: Stabschef des Wehrkreises VI.
Brauchitsch wird Abteilungsleiter der Heeresausbildung im Reichswehrministerium.
am 1. Februar 1933 Kommandeur der 1. Division und Befehlshaber im Wehrkreis I
1937 als General der Artillerie Befehlshaber des Gruppenkommandos 4
erhält den Oberbefehl über sämtliche motorisierten Verbände des Heers.

body.zh-Hant: 1938年，在弗里奇—布隆貝格事件之後，他接替被希特勒罷黜的弗里奇出任陸軍總司令。他在波蘭、法國與蘇聯戰役中指導陸軍作戰，1940年7月19日晉升元帥。1941年12月19日，希特勒把冬季戰役的失敗歸咎於他並將他免職，自己接掌陸軍指揮權。
body.en: In 1938, after the Fritsch–Blomberg affair, he replaced Colonel-General von Fritsch, whom Hitler had removed, as Commander-in-Chief of the Army. He directed the army's operations in Poland, France and the Soviet Union and was promoted field marshal on 19 July 1940. On 19 December 1941 Hitler made him the scapegoat for the failure of the Russian winter campaign and dismissed him, taking over the army command himself.

citations.quote: wird Brauchitsch Oberbefehlshaber des Heers.
An Stelle des von
Generalobersten Freiherr von Fritsch wurde er 1938 Oberbefehlshaber des Heeres.
zum Sündenbock für das Mißlingen des russischen Winterfeldzugs
leitet Brauchitsch die militärischen Operationen des Heers in Polen
den er am 19.7.1940 zum Generalfeldmarschall befördert hatte
entließ ihn am 19.12.1941

body.zh-Hant: 1944年8月20日他在《民族觀察家報》上發表文章，把七月二十日事件稱為一個「瘋狂的行為」，一般認為其用意是為一名親近的被捕者向希特勒說情。他在紐倫堡被作為證人訊問，1948年10月18日在英軍醫院羈押中去世，審判尚未開始。
body.en: On 20 August 1944 he published an article in the Völkischer Beobachter condemning the events of 20 July, apparently to be able to intercede with Hitler for an arrested acquaintance. He was questioned as a witness at Nuremberg and died on 18 October 1948 in British military custody in Hamburg before his trial opened.

offenbar, um sich für einen ihm nahestehenden Verhafteten bei

body.zh-Hant: 1891年1月24日生於根廷。1909年中學畢業後以軍校生身分進入科特布斯的第52步兵團，1914年隨該團第1營出征，任營副官。1919年他被接收進國防軍，組織自庫爾蘭撤回的志願兵部隊，1929年調入國防部陸軍訓練處，1934年任步兵團團長。
body.en: He was born in Genthin on 24 January 1891. After the Abitur in 1909 he joined Infantry Regiment 52 at Cottbus as an officer cadet and went to war in 1914 as adjutant of its 1st Battalion. In 1919 he was taken into the Reichswehr and organised the return of the volunteer units from Courland, moved to the army training department of the Reichswehr ministry in 1929, and in 1934 commanded an infantry regiment.

body.zh-Hant: 1938年他任德勒斯登第4軍的參謀長，1939年參加波蘭戰役，1940年任第16集團軍參謀長參加法國戰役。1940年11月13日他任第3裝甲師師長，1941年10月26日任第41軍軍長；12月4日他的部隊推進到莫斯科以北數公里處，隨後被蘇軍擊退。
body.en: In 1938 he was chief of staff of IV Army Corps in Dresden, took part in the Polish campaign in 1939 and in the French campaign in 1940 as chief of staff of the 16th Army. On 13 November 1940 he became commander of the 3rd Panzer Division and on 26 October 1941 commanding general of XXXXI Army Corps; on 4 December his units reached a point a few kilometres north of Moscow before being thrown back.

heading.zh-Hant: 第9集團軍與勒熱夫、堡壘作戰

body.zh-Hant: 1942年1月18日他接掌在勒熱夫突出部受到猛攻的第9集團軍，1942年2月1日晉升上將；他在1943年2月28日至3月22日執行了東線唯一一次有計畫的撤退「水牛行動」。1943年7月5日起，他的集團軍積極參與了庫爾斯克與奧廖爾突出部的「堡壘」作戰，11月3日他被調入元首預備隊。
body.en: On 18 January 1942 he took over the Ninth Army, hard pressed in the Rzhev salient, and became Generaloberst on 1 February 1942; he carried out the only planned retreat on the Eastern Front, the "Büffel" movement, from 28 February to 22 March 1943. From 5 July 1943 his army took a leading part in Operation Citadel in the Kursk and Orel salients, and on 3 November 1943 he was put into the Führer reserve.

body.zh-Hant: 1944年1月31日他受命指揮北方集團軍群，3月1日晉升元帥，3月31日改任北烏克蘭集團軍群。1944年8月16日他接替克魯格出任西線總司令兼B集團軍群司令，9月4日交出西線總司令職務；12月他參與策劃並指揮阿登攻勢，1945年4月17日在魯爾包圍圈中解散B集團軍群，4月21日自殺。
body.en: On 31 January 1944 he was entrusted with Army Group North, became field marshal on 1 March and on 31 March took over Army Group North Ukraine. On 16 August 1944, succeeding Kluge, he was made Oberbefehlshaber West and commander of Army Group B; he gave up the western command on 4 September. In December he helped plan and lead the Ardennes offensive; on 17 April 1945 he dissolved Army Group B in the Ruhr pocket and on 21 April he committed suicide.

body.zh-Hant: 海因茨·古德里安於1888年6月17日生於西普魯士的庫爾姆，是普魯士軍官之子。他先後在卡爾斯魯厄與柏林的軍校受教，1907年進入陸軍，1908年以少尉身分配屬戈斯拉爾的獵兵營。第一次世界大戰開始後，他在西線擔任通信軍官，1917年轉入總參謀部。
body.en: Heinz Guderian was born on 17 June 1888 in Kulm, West Prussia, the son of a Prussian officer. After attending cadet schools in Karlsruhe and Berlin he entered the army in 1907, and in 1908 he was assigned as a lieutenant to the Jäger Battalion at Goslar. After the First World War began he served as a signals officer on the Western Front, and in 1917 he moved into the General Staff.

body.zh-Hant: 1931年他出任交通兵監察部參謀長，1935年10月德軍編成最初三個裝甲師，他獲得第2裝甲師的指揮權。1938年11月，他成為裝甲兵上將並兼任快速部隊總監。LeMO 稱他為德國現代化、強大裝甲兵的創建者。
body.en: In 1931 he became chief of staff of the Inspectorate of Motor Transport Troops. When the first three Panzer divisions were formed in October 1935 he received command of the 2nd Panzer Division, and in November 1938 he became General of Panzer Troops and chief of the fast troops. LeMO calls him the creator of a modern and powerful Panzer force in Germany.

body.zh-Hant: 1939年9、10月波蘭戰役期間，他擔任機動化第19軍的指揮官。1940年6月法蘭西會戰中，他經凡爾登向瑞士邊境推進。1941年6月德軍進攻蘇聯時，他指揮第2裝甲集群，後來擴編的第2裝甲軍團在10月打贏布良斯克包圍戰。12月25日，他因擅自拉直戰線而被希特勒免職。
body.en: During the Polish campaign in September and October 1939 he commanded the motorised XIX Army Corps. In the battle of France in June 1940 he advanced via Verdun towards the Swiss border. When Germany attacked the Soviet Union in June 1941 he led Panzer Group 2, whose expanded 2nd Panzer Army won the encirclement battle of Bryansk in October. On 25 December he was dismissed by Hitler over his unauthorised straightening of the front.

body.zh-Hant: 1943年3月他被重新啟用為裝甲兵總監。1944年7月21日，他接替失寵的蔡茨勒出任陸軍總參謀長；1945年3月28日，在與希特勒激烈爭執後被免職。其後他被美軍俘虜，1954年5月14日在富森附近的施旺高去世。權威檔稱他為陸軍軍官，指揮過較大的裝甲部隊。
body.en: In March 1943 he was recalled as Inspector-General of Panzer Troops. On 21 July 1944 he succeeded Kurt Zeitzler, who had fallen out of favour, as Chief of the General Staff, and on 28 March 1945 he was dismissed after severe quarrels with Hitler. He was then held in American captivity and died on 14 May 1954 in Schwangau near Füssen. The authority file describes him as an army officer who commanded larger armoured formations.
